sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 100. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 60% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 30% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 10% Life Drain for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Awakening. (Activates for 60 seconds when HP reaches 60% or below.)
Time elemental defense boosted by 50 when equipped in the Main Slot.
